reason: I don't buy supplements unless my doctor says so, and at $34k a year $25 to $30 a month for magnesium is money I'd rather keep. The lab report is nice, but I still don't know if it would do anything for me.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium, so I'd be paying every month for something that may do nothing.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me I'm low on magnesium or should take it for sleep, and a smaller trial box for around $10.
